newsitem.title: USA: Epitope completes Andrew and Williamson deal.
newsitem.headline: Epitope completes Andrew and Williamson deal.

text.p: Epitope Inc said on Friday it has completed its acquisition of Andrew and Williamson Sales Co, a San Diego-based fruit and vegetable producer, in exchange for 520,000 of its common shares.
Andrew and Williamson is a wholly owned operating unit of Epitope, a biotechnology company that develops new drugs at its Epitope Medical Products group and new plants at Agritope.

Andrews and Williamson provides sales and distribution services for growers in Mexico, the Baja peninsula and California. In the year ending September 30, A&W had sales of $62.5 million and net income before taxes of $1.3 million.
